 West Indies captain Roston Chase has won the toss and decided to bat first in the second and final cricket test against Bangladesh. West Indies won the first test by eight wickets in Dhaka. Top-order batter Kevin Wickham makes his debut and Joshua Da Silva returns to the side in two changes for West Indies, replacing John Campbell and Tagnarine Chanderpaul, who both are out with a viral fever. Bangladesh also made two changes. Veteran Mushfiqur Rahim returns to the squad after missing the first test due to a finger injury along with pacer Taskin Ahmed.

 West Indies captain Roston Chase has won the toss and decided to bat first in the second and final cricket test against Bangladesh 
 AP 
 Nov 4, 2026 
 1 hr ago 
 SYLHET, Bangladesh (AP) — West Indies captain Roston Chase won the toss and decided to bat first in the second and final cricket test against Bangladesh on Thursday.
 West Indies won the first test by eight wickets in Dhaka.
